name: JSW Infrastructure Limited
summary: JSW Infrastructure Limited, an infrastructure development company, operates commercial ports in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Port Operations and Logistic Operation. The company's activities include developing, operating, and maintaining port services; ports related infrastructure development activities; and developing infrastructure projects. It also provides terminal-related, cargo handling, storage, logistics, transportation, and other value-added services. In addition, the company develops and operates ports and port terminals.
